title: Sugar Dunes Condo #13 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home is thoughtfully designed with an open concept layout that keeps the Gulf in view from every shared space. The living area flows into a well equipped kitchen with bar seating and a spacious dining area, creating a natural gathering point for meals and evenings together. Expansive glass doors open onto the beachfront balcony, inviting in natural light and coastal air while maintaining a relaxed, refined feel throughout. The home comfortably accommodates guests across three well appointed bedrooms, including two king suites and a bunk room with two twin over twin bunks, offering flexibility for families or groups traveling together. Elevator access and in home laundry add an additional layer of ease to your stay. Loved this very clean and updated condo on a private drive with a full time security guard who takes his job seriously. While still in the heart of 30A, this condo feels like it is on an island all its own. The private beach made each day enjoyable and peaceful. Chairs/umbrella were provided and the property was safely gated. Parking was strict and golf carts are NOT allowed on the property, however, you can still park them on the street outside of the gated lot if you do end up renting a golf cart FYI. The easy access to the beach from our balcony was wonderful, the appliances were new, beds were comfortable, many beach toys were provided in the balcony closet, and views were incredible. Will certainly rent here again.
